Beyond the glass: a warm cream-and-honey lobby with polished pale stone floor, soft amber ceiling downlights, a low reception desk, potted plants and a quietly lit escalator. Strictly warm tungsten and soft white lighting; the scene contains no green, cyan or magenta light sources and no coloured LED strips.
